title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Ah, thank you.
I'm always grateful for your hospitality.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
So, how have you been lately?
I hope you're feeling well.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
I bought some shortcake from that bakery by the station.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
You like these quite a lot if I recall.
Please have some with Ms. Yoisaki later.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: It's okay for you to tell me whatever it is that's on your mind, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: But you also don't have to if you don't want to tell me.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: However, I'm here because I want to know how you're feeling. I'm here to listen.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't actually like this cake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for misunderstanding.
Then, can you tell me what you do like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I haven't been able to taste anything for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Everything I eat... It's all the same to me...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: If possible, could you tell me?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Mafuyu seems more comfortable talking compared to before...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And her dad's making an effort to understand what's going on with her. Thank goodness...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I hope things start moving in a positive direction...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Then, I'll be back again next week.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
But I'm a little tired...
I'm going to rest for a bit.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, I'll be working in my room.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? A call? Who could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<Kanade?
It's your grandmother. Are you free to talk now?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there a reason you called?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I was wondering how you've been doing, Kanade. Is everything okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay.
Mafuyu... My friend's also doing well.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And thanks to Ms. Mochizuki, I've been eating much more regularly. Also, my room's much cleaner now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<Oh, that's wonderful to hear...!
I'll need to thank Honami again the next chance I get.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <By the way, Kanade, I heard that you went to your school's opening ceremony...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line:
<So, how was it?
Were there changes or anything bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, there's nothing in particular...
I've been keeping up with my studies as usual.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Dad also seems fine.
Not much has changed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <By the way, Kanade, have you been thinking about your future at all?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I know that's difficult to do considering your father's condition...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I believe it's about time for you to start thinking more seriously about your own future.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <Yes. For starters, what are you going to do after you graduate? You need to begin planning for that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <That's why I'd like to hear what you think, Kanade. What would you like to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What would I like to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I know I'm throwing a tough question at you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I hope you'll give it some thought when you get a chance... This is your future we're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <And I'll support you on whatever endeavors you decide to embark on...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I believe it's about time for you to start thinking more seriously about your own future.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <Yes. For starters, what are you going to do after you graduate? You need to begin planning for that.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <That's why I'd like to hear what you think, Kanade. What would you like to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've never given it much thought before.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I've been investing all of my time into composing songs that could save people...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't really know what I want to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing...
Anything other than that seems...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You have school tomorrow, don't you, Mafuyu? It's getting late, so why don't you go first?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh, K.
About what your envisioning for this song...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <About this song... Actually, is everything okay? It seems like you've been having trouble concentrating today.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<My grandma called me today.
She told me that I should probably start thinking about what I want to do after I graduate...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I'm not sure what I'm going to do since I've been spending all my time composing music...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, who actually knows what they want to do in the future?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I haven't even had time to give my own future any serious thought...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. I want to keep drawing, but I don't know what to do about art school and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, right. Art schools are super competitive, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But it'd be great if you got into a school where you can further pursue art since you're so passionate about it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we're on the subject, K, is there anything you want to do after you graduate?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Honestly, I kind of want to just keep composing like I've always been...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, that's not what I'm talking about.
I'm trying to ask you if...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, are you asking what she “wants” to do instead of what she feels that she “has” to do...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah! Just like how Enanan wants to keep drawing. Isn't there something like that that really drives you?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I have to keep composing.
Nothing else really drives me the same way...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry...
I still can't think of anything else...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <To be fair, this is your life we're talking about. You don't want to make any hasty decisions.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I still don't even know what I'm gonna do yet, so I think you should take your time...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Not gonna lie, I'm a little relieved...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, K, you're always working really hard for the sake of others...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You compose songs in the hopes that you'll save someone. Yuki, for example... You've even done a lot for us.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Which is why I'm glad that you're getting a chance to think about yourself for a change...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I see what you mean.
K does usually put others before herself.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Exactly.
I really admire that. I have a huge amount of respect for you...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I also think you should take more time to do the things that you want, K. The things you think are fun.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hnng... It's three in the morning already? I might go to bed...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I want to keep working until morning, but I was told that I need to be at school tomorrow.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, Enanan, if you really wanna go to art school, shouldn't you start working on being able to wake up in the morning?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Haha! Anyway, I'm gonna log off.
Night, everyone!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think I'm at a good place to stop, so I'm also going to log off. I'll send over what I have now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll go take a bath.
I am starting to get a little sleepy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I need to finish this by morning...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I know I'm throwing a tough question at you...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Grandmother
rows.Line: <But I hope you'll give it some thought when you get a chance... This is your future we're talking about.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <But I also think you should take more time to do the things that you want, K. The things you think are fun.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The things I want to do...
The things I think are fun....)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I did have fun that one time when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I wanted to compose warm and soothing songs like the ones Dad did...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I composed those songs because I liked his so much.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Now I've only ever been able to focus on what I have to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(I'm not really sure...
But I think it's something more than what I need to do...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm having trouble focusing now, so I should probably take a break...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Mafuyu was able to start moving forward because she fought back against her mom that day...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (And that has caused things to change in this SEKAI. This new area appearing is proof of that.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What is it? What do you want...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm here for something else, not you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You brought your sketchbook...?
Are you going to draw something?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I promised Ena that I'd do a drawing of the lake for her.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You don't have to.
You're not in the way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, I could include you in my drawing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's Kanade. Do you think something happened to her?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, KAITO, aren't you gonna go see her with me...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I don't need to if you're going.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (She's trying to compose a song that'll save Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (But I don't know why she is or what's driving her to do so.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll go have a quick look...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can hear music coming from that lake again today...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It's a song that I composed for N25...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (When did I work on this one?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I don't think we'd met each other in person yet. Now I'm starting to feel all this nostalgia...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Back then, I was so desperate about composing a song that could save someone.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So desperate that I started eating and sleeping less, which worried Ms. Mochizuki a lot.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, all I've been doing is composing songs...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That's true now, but also before I even formed N25.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You seem to have a lot on your mind today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, actually, I've been thinking about myself.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes... But my problems are small compared to Mafuyu's, so there's no need for you to worry.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I kinda want to hear what's going on with you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna help Mafuyu, but I also wanna help you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, thank you...
The thing is...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What does music mean to you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I've been wondering that for a little while now, but can't seem to find the answer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All I had been thinking about was composing songs that can save people. That's what I thought I had to do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But now, I'm wondering if I should be feeling something else...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's where I'm stuck.
I don't know what I should be feeling...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why did you start composing songs, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I really love the songs he composed...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They were happy, gentle and always made my mom smile.
A dozen or so years earlier

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I should probably drop the tempo here a little. And then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Huh...? Kanade, you're in your father's room again. How many times do I have to tell you that he's working?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Haha. That's fine, dear.
I'll feel more motivated knowing that she's watching.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Yes. Actually, I'm nearly done working on this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Would you like to hear it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Okay, I'll play a part of it. Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: That's amazing, Daddy! You're like a wizard!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Haha. I'm not as amazing as you think I am. However, if you like it that much, then this song's sure to become a big hit.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet everyone's gonna really, really love it!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Daddy, can you show me how to make songs like this one?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Oh, Kanade, would you like to learn how to make music?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Because Daddy's songs always make you, me and everyone else smile, Mommy!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
Then, I promise to show you when you're a little older.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I loved watching him create, which is why I spent so much time sitting next to him.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Yes, since your father's birthday is coming up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: We'll prepare a party in secret and surprise him on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. He probably won't know what to do with himself after he finds out that you helped, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: So, would you mind lending me a hand?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
What would make him really happy?!
Oh, we should bake him a cake! I wanna puts lots and lots of whipped cream and strawberries on it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Yes, he does like shortcake very much.
Why don't we bake one for him together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Of course.
Let's make him the yummiest cake we can!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: What else can we do for him?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (Our surprise party's gonna be so much fun...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, also...!
I wanna give Daddy a present.)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (Hmm... It should be in this cupboard...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Hm? Kanade...?
Is that your father's old keyboard? Did you bring it out?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I, uhh...!
I thought I could draw this and...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
You're going to draw a picture?
You didn't have to bring this one out. There's a much nicer one you can use as a model...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
N-No, I wanna draw this one...!
I need to focus, Mommy, so can you go somewhere else please?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Understood.
In that case, have fun.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Okay, if I press here, it should make a noise...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Now I can compose my own song...!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, but how do I make mine sound like Daddy's...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, what are you doing all the way over there? You can sit next to me like you always do...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I have to keep things a secret!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
You keep working, Daddy.
Pretend like I'm not here.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Press here and here together, and then...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
That sounded a lot like what Daddy did...!

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, which ones did I press just now?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Mommy! Mommy!
Is there anything you wanna tell Daddy?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Your father?
Hmm... I should ask him what he'd like for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
No, not about dinner!
I'm talking about his birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
Are you writing a letter to him?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah.
It's gonna be his present...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
Hehe. In that case...
“Happy Birthday.
The songs you compose are always so gentle and...”

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Once again, dear, we'd like to wish you a very happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you both so much.
This really was a surprise.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: This feast you've prepared looks absolutely delicious. I really wasn't expecting anything like this.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Kanade and I baked the cake together.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: Frosting the cake was really hard, but I did my best!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you very much, Kanade.
This cake looks delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Also, dear, Kanade's prepared a present for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Wait, Kanade, I thought you were writing a letter.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Hehe. Nope...
My present to you, Daddy, is...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: A song! It's called “Mommy And Me Really Love You!”

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line:
These lyrics...
It's what we talked about the other day...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (Mommy and Daddy both look so surprised....! Hehe. I'm so glad!)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (Uh oh... How do I play the next part again...?)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
(Oh, this works too...
It's not what I practiced, but I can just keep playing like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, did you come up with that all on your own...?

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line:
Yup!
I don't know if it was as good as your songs, Daddy...

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: But you always seem to have a lot of fun whenever you sing, so I thought you'd like it if I sang for you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: I agree! I had no idea you were working on your own song...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Better than that!
I don't know what to say... I couldn't be happier...

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: I'm also incredibly happy about you turning what I said into the lyrics for your song!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Thank you for coming up with such a lovely melody for them! You did a wonderful job!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You really did... It was nice. It felt so warm.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Do you think you can compose another song for me sometime, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: But to think that a girl her age can compose her own songs... I guess that makes Kanade our little prodigy.

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. Mommy and Daddy liked my song so much...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Kanade
rows.Line: (I bet they'd really love it if I composed another one for them...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That was the first song I ever composed.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: After that, I started composing more songs while receiving advice from my dad.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Like what kind of songs would make both my parents smile...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And what would make them feel happy...
I wanted to compose those kinds of songs.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You must really love your mom and dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My mom always knew how to make me feel better... If I ever felt scared or worried she'd give me a hug, and she always sang lullabies to me whenever it was bedtime...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
My dad was also really nice...
He always praised me and gave me pats on the head.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Whenever we were all together, everything felt so warm and happy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They'd always smile whenever I composed a new song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Which always puts a smile on my face...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand now that music means everything to you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Music was always a part of our lives in some way... And that's what made us happy.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which is why I love music so much...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is something wrong?
You don't look so good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I should head back...
I need to finish working on that song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Because my goal is still to compose songs that can save people...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay, and I'm sorry for making you worry...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you for listening.
I feel a little better now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll come back once our song's finished...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (I didn't know that's why she's composing these songs.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Which is likely striking a chord with Mafuyu.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: She clearly tried to suppress whatever she was feeling just now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I can't go back and change what happened that day...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I have to keep composing.
That's all I can do now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I feel pretty refreshed now.
I might actually be able to finish one of my illustrations.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll be working like normal, so let me know if anything comes up.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K, I wanna ask you something...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <My illustration for the post-chorus feels kinda dark at the moment, but I'm wondering if I should add a little more light... What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, sorry...
I was thinking about something else, so I couldn't gather my thoughts properly.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, are you talking about your future...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It's not bothering me that much, but it does keep nagging at me.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But I'm okay...
I feel a lot better after talking with Rin just now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I tried thinking about what I want to do, but I couldn't come up with anything...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <However, there was a time when I really loved music more than anything else...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Sure. My happiest memories all seem to involve music in some way...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <My mom and dad always smiled whenever they heard a song that I composed.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That explains why your songs feel so warm, K.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <The memories you just mentioned might be the source of the warmth I feel in your songs. It makes so much sense now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <So, are you gonna keep composing after you graduate?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, um... Yes.
I plan to keep on composing.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Especially... Since that's what I need to do...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I realized something while talking about this...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <No matter how many songs I do compose, I'll never be able to feel the warmth I did back then ever again...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I know there's nothing I can do about that now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But my dad losing his ability to compose is still my fault...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That's why I need to keep composing. For him. For everyone.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <If I can compose songs that save others, then I'll...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I know you feel awful about what happened to your dad, but there's no point in beating yourself up...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What I'm trying to say is... I think your happiness is a separate issue.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Personally, I don't want those two things being so closely tied together...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, you're working so hard for the sake of others...! You deserve to be happy too!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: Wanting to learn how to write wonderful songs like your father is a beautiful dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Mother
rows.Line: But I'll be happy as long as you find something that makes you happy, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You tried to suppress whatever you were feeling just now...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <You believe that you're not allowed to be happy. That you have no right to.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <I'm okay with you composing songs in order to save others and make them feel happy.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <But I'm not okay with you turning a blind eye to what you're really feeling...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Before you formed N25, and even now... The songs you've composed have helped me so much.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Every time I listen to one of your songs whenever I'm not feeling great... Whenever I wonder if I should continue drawing, the thought of creating art for N25 keeps me going.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I feel pain sometimes when I'm working on an illustration... But I want to keep drawing.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Plus, I've actually started thinking about what I wanna do after I graduate.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I doubt I'd be giving that any serious thought if I hadn't joined N25...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You're the reason why I'm even thinking about my own future.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's a small step, but I have something to work towards now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<So, Kanade...
I think you should also do what makes you the happiest.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If there is something you wish to do, you shouldn't fight against it.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Because there's no way you'll be able to save her if you don't cherish your own feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<KAITO, wait!
Ugh. He always storms off after saying whatever it is that's on his mind...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for me to do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Am I allowed to feel the way I did back then...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I robbed Dad of his future...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. She visited a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she said she was feeling better, but I'm still a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, hello. Mafuyu and the others should also be arriving shortly since I'll have them listen to the new demo today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But before they come, there's a song I'd like for you all to hear...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels a little different from your usual songs, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree...
Normally, I'd feel warm and light after my chest tightened up a little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this one feels so happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I took some time to think a little after we last spoke...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that joy I felt back then is never coming back, and I can't change what happened to my dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay with at least asking myself, “What if there's a way?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I composed a song based on what I felt when I worked on my very first song...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I don't plan on uploading it online since it feels a little too happy in terms of N25.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I really like this song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'd be a shame if no one else gets to hear it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, so you should have Mafuyu and the others also listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What were you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's a song I'd like for you all to listen to.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry for running a little late today, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do you feel? It's been getting chilly lately. I bought this sweater for you since it seemed warm. I hope you get a chance to wear it sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Dad, do you remember when I composed a song by myself for the very first time...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I tried composing one based on what I felt back then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It probably feels a little different to the songs I'm composing now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I made this one in the hopes that you'd remember how happy you and Mom were back then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ever since that day, I've been trying to compose songs that make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't do what you were able to, Dad, but there is someone who really needs my songs now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's in a really tough situation at the moment, which is why I'm going to keep trying to save her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I can do that... If I can make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe, I can be even a little bit as good a composer as you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And if I can do that...
Maybe you'll remember who I am.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And then, like the way things used to be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you pat my head...
And praise me for not giving up all this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Even for just a moment...
If it means regaining...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I probably have no right wishing for something like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think it's okay for me to right now...)
